text: GENERALISED. I filed the contradictory rdm(crossnobis_plan) message here as a single instance. Smoke-testing the export surface turned up the mirror case - crossnobis(geometry(plan)) telling a user holding an effect_geometry that the argument must be a compiled geometry - so this is a systematic vocabulary inversion rather than one bad string. Moved to bd-01KZYM1W0WAWVX5MY4T35VYCQH; the feature request on this bead is unaffected.
